description: This file is a Perl script (`tftypes.pl`) used for generating Java source code files related to TensorFlow types. It processes type description files and template files to produce Java classes and methods, primarily for the TensorFlow Java API. The script is used for automating code generation based on TensorFlow type definitions.

methods.name: usage
methods.description: Prints usage instructions for the script.

methods.name: trim
methods.description: Trims whitespace from the beginning and end of a string.

methods.name: article
methods.description: Returns a string 'a' or 'an' based on the initial vowel or digit of the input string, for grammatical correctness.
